<thought>We need the precursors for the Doebner Modification retrosynthesis of the given product. The product contains a sulfonamide attached to a phenyl ring bearing a cinnamic acid side chain. Retrosynthetically, this side chain originates from an aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid. Thus the precursors are the same sulfonamide with an aldehyde instead of the alkene‑acid, and malonic acid itself.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1\", \"O=C(O)C(C(=O)O)\"]]</final_answer>
